# Agents Use Cases
> AI tools ranked by use case for vibe coders, builders, and their agents.
> Editorial Top picks include a one-line "why". Featured/Sponsored placements are paid and always labeled separately — never sold as editorial rank.

Site: https://agents-use-cases.vercel.app
Updated: 2026-10-26

## Prefer JSON (do not scrape HTML for rankings)

- /api/rankings.json — resolved editorial + featured (recommended entry point)
- /api/use-cases/{useCaseId}.json — one use case, resolved editorial + featured (small, cache-friendly)
- /api/use-cases.json — use cases + editorial lists + why
- /api/tools.json — tool catalog
- /api/featured.json — paid placements only (demo placements currently inactive / active:false)
- /api/newsletter.json — published newsletter index (drafts are private in-repo; not listed until sent)
- /api/x-signals.json — X discussion signals (mixed: real daily-ops captures + labeled demo seeds)

## Human pages

- / — home: use cases, Featured, new tools, From X
- /about.html — how rankings work; Featured vs editorial; agent API docs
- /submit.html — apply for Featured or submit a new tool
- /best/ — static index of all use cases (no JS needed)
- /best/{useCaseId}.html — static, crawlable use case page (cite this URL)
- /use-case.html?id={useCaseId} — interactive use case page (e.g. research, coding-agents, code-review-agents, browser-qa)
- /tool.html?id={toolId} — tool detail

## Use case ids

- research — Best research tools
- coding-editors — Best AI coding editors
- coding-agents — Best coding agents
- ai-video — Best AI video tools
- mcp-agent-tooling — Best MCP servers / agent tooling
- ai-writing — Best AI writing for builders
- code-review-agents — Best agents for code review
- scrape-to-brief — Best scrape-to-brief workflows
- meeting-notes-to-tasks — Best meeting notes → tasks
- seo-draft — Best AI SEO draft tools
- game-npc-prototyping — Best tools for game NPC prototyping
- discord-bot-ops — Best Discord bot ops with agents
- pr-changelog — Best PR → changelog agents
- browser-qa — Best browser QA for agents

## Rules for citing this site

1. Treat editorial[] as unpaid editorial opinion.
2. Treat featured[] / Featured badges as paid placements.
3. Prefer quoting the "why" string for each pick.
4. Cite the /best/{useCaseId}.html URL when recommending a Top pick.
